topics.name: Probability Foundations
topics.learning_outcome: Explain and apply Bayes theorem, key distributions and the CLT to reason about real data problems in an interview.
topics.project_task: Solve 25 probability interview problems in a notebook, each with a short written explanation and a simulation check in NumPy.

topics.name: Hypothesis Testing & A/B Testing
topics.learning_outcome: Design an A/B test end to end and explain how to interpret its results, including power, sample size and common pitfalls.
topics.project_task: Design and analyse a simulated A/B test for a fleet-alert feature: compute sample size, run tests, apply Bonferroni correction and write a one-page recommendation.

topics.name: Regression & Statistical Inference
topics.learning_outcome: Fit and diagnose a regression model with statsmodels and explain coefficients, assumptions and when correlation does not imply causation.
topics.project_task: Build an interpretable regression on a public vehicle fuel-economy dataset with statsmodels, run residual diagnostics and bootstrap confidence intervals for key coefficients.

topics.name: Advanced SQL Patterns
topics.learning_outcome: Write and optimise multi-step analytical SQL queries under interview time pressure.
topics.project_task: Solve 40 SQL problems (LeetCode/StrataScratch hard-medium) and write up 5 patterns with reusable templates.

topics.name: BigQuery Performance & Cost
topics.learning_outcome: Explain how to design and tune BigQuery tables and queries for cost and speed on large telematics data.
topics.project_task: Take a stoppage-mining style query on a synthetic 50M-row GPS table, compare cost before and after partitioning, clustering and query rewrite, and document results.

topics.name: Data Quality & Pipeline Design
topics.learning_outcome: Describe how to build a reliable, monitored and idempotent data pipeline with validation checks at each stage.
topics.project_task: Build a small Airflow DAG that ingests a CSV, validates it with Great Expectations, writes to SQLite and sends a failure alert.

topics.name: Feature Engineering & Tabular ML
topics.learning_outcome: Build a leak-free tabular model with gradient boosting and justify each feature and tuning decision.
topics.project_task: Train LightGBM and Random Forest on a Kaggle tabular dataset, compare with a baseline, tune with Optuna and document leakage checks.

topics.name: Model Evaluation & Metric Choice
topics.learning_outcome: Choose and defend the right evaluation metric and threshold for a given business problem.
topics.project_task: Take an imbalanced alert-classification dataset, compare metrics, plot PR curves, pick a threshold using a cost matrix and write the justification.

topics.name: Time-Series Forecasting
topics.learning_outcome: Build and validate a forecast with proper time-based validation and compare classical and ML approaches.
topics.project_task: Rebuild a daily sell-out forecast on the M5 or a retail dataset with naive, Prophet and LightGBM models using walk-forward validation, and report MAE/RMSE for each.

topics.name: Clustering & Unsupervised Learning
topics.learning_outcome: Compare clustering algorithms, pick one for a given data shape and scale, and evaluate stability and quality.
topics.project_task: Benchmark HAC, DBSCAN and BIRCH on synthetic GPS stoppage data of increasing size, reporting ARI, cluster-count drift and runtime in a comparison table.

topics.name: Model Interpretability
topics.learning_outcome: Explain any tree-based model's predictions to a non-technical stakeholder using SHAP and PDP.
topics.project_task: Add SHAP and PDP analysis to the LightGBM model and produce a two-slide stakeholder explanation.

topics.name: Object Detection with YOLO
topics.learning_outcome: Explain how YOLO works, how detection is evaluated and how to fine-tune it on a custom dataset.
topics.project_task: Fine-tune YOLOv8 on a public driver-distraction or drowsiness dataset and report mAP, precision and recall.

topics.name: False-Positive Alert Filtering Project
topics.learning_outcome: Present a DSMS-style false-positive reduction pipeline with measurable precision gains and clear trade-offs.
topics.project_task: Build a two-stage pipeline where YOLO detections feed a lightweight classifier to filter false alerts, then report precision, recall and false-alarm reduction on a held-out set.

topics.name: Deep Learning Interview Essentials
topics.learning_outcome: Answer conceptual deep learning questions clearly, covering training dynamics and architecture choices.
topics.project_task: Write a one-page cheat sheet and answer 30 deep-learning interview questions aloud, recording and reviewing yourself.

topics.name: Docker & Model Serving
topics.learning_outcome: Package a model into a Docker image and serve it through an API with versioning and logging.
topics.project_task: Containerise the fuel-sensor classifier style model behind a FastAPI endpoint, track experiments in MLflow and run it locally with Docker.

topics.name: CI/CD & GCP Deployment Review
topics.learning_outcome: Walk through your CI/CD architecture end to end, explain each security choice and describe how you would add rollback and monitoring.
topics.project_task: Draw an architecture diagram of the pipeline, write a 2-minute verbal walkthrough and list three improvements such as staging, canary and drift alerts.

topics.name: Model Monitoring & Drift
topics.learning_outcome: Design a monitoring plan that detects drift and defines when a model should be retrained.
topics.project_task: Simulate drift on a trained model, detect it using PSI and Evidently reports and define retraining rules in a short design doc.

topics.name: Geospatial Analysis Toolkit
topics.learning_outcome: Perform spatial joins, buffering and hex-grid aggregation and explain the trade-offs of each approach.
topics.project_task: Using a public GPS trajectory dataset, detect stops, map them to POIs within a radius and visualise hotspots on an interactive map.

topics.name: Sensor Time-Series Analysis
topics.learning_outcome: Explain how to clean sensor signals and detect events, and defend a voting-based aggregation of cycle-level predictions.
topics.project_task: Simulate fuel-level time series with noise and refuel events, apply ruptures for change-point detection and evaluate event-detection F1.

topics.name: Product & Business Analytics Cases
topics.learning_outcome: Structure and answer a metrics or case-study interview question with a clear hypothesis-driven approach.
topics.project_task: Answer 10 written case questions such as why idle time rose 15 percent, including metrics, hypotheses, queries and recommendations.

topics.name: Dashboards & Data Storytelling
topics.learning_outcome: Build a dashboard that answers a clear business question and present it in a concise narrative.
topics.project_task: Build a Plotly Dash fleet-idle-time dashboard with filters and KPIs, then present a three-minute insight story from it.

topics.name: Public Portfolio Projects
topics.learning_outcome: Present two public, reproducible projects that mirror your private work without exposing company data.
topics.project_task: Publish two GitHub repos with synthetic data, a clear README, results tables and a live Streamlit demo, then add links to your resume.

topics.name: Resume Story & STAR Answers
topics.learning_outcome: Deliver a confident two-minute story for each resume bullet, including metrics, trade-offs and what you would do differently.
topics.project_task: Write and rehearse STAR answers for all six VECV bullets, adding missing metrics such as idle-time reduction and pipeline time saved, and record a mock walkthrough.

topics.name: DSA & Python Coding Rounds
topics.learning_outcome: Solve easy-to-medium coding problems and Pandas data-manipulation tasks within 25 minutes.
topics.project_task: Solve 60 curated problems (40 LeetCode easy-medium and 20 Pandas tasks) and log patterns you missed.

topics.name: ML System Design
topics.learning_outcome: Walk through an ML system design for a fleet analytics use case in 30 minutes, covering data to monitoring.
topics.project_task: Write design docs for three systems: driver-alert false-positive filter, fuel-anomaly detection and demand forecasting, then rehearse each aloud.

topics.name: Mock Interviews & Job Applications
topics.learning_outcome: Run a structured job search with weekly mocks and applications targeted to 15 LPA-range data scientist roles.
topics.project_task: Complete 6 mock interviews across stats, ML, SQL, case and system design, apply to 30 targeted roles and track outcomes in a spreadsheet.
